useWhen: Setting up infrastructure with code using Terraform

workflow.description: Define requirements, select cloud provider, design architecture
Create Terraform/CloudFormation, organize modules, manage state
Set up networking, security, and resource configurations
Review plan, apply changes, verify resources

examples.input: Set up AWS infrastructure for a web application with EC2, RDS, and load balancer using Terraform.
examples.output:
**TERRAFORM STRUCTURE**

```
project/
├── main.tf
├── variables.tf
├── outputs.tf
├── modules/
│   ├── vpc/
│   ├── ec2/
│   └── rds/
└── environments/
    ├── dev/
    └── prod/
```

**VPC MODULE**

```hcl
# modules/vpc/main.tf
resource "aws_vpc" "main" {
  cidr_block           = var.vpc_cidr
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
  enable_dns_support  = true
}

resource "aws_subnet" "public" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = var.public_subnet_cidr
  map_public_ip_on_launch = true
}

resource "aws_subnet" "private" {
  vpc_id                  = aws_vpc.main.id
  cidr_block              = var.private_subnet_cidr
}
```

**MAIN CONFIGURATION**

```hcl
# main.tf
module "vpc" {
  source = "./modules/vpc"
  
  vpc_cidr           = "10.0.0.0/16"
  public_subnet_cidr = "10.0.1.0/24"
  private_subnet_cidr = "10.0.2.0/24"
}

module "ec2" {
  source = "./modules/ec2"
  
  instance_type = "t3.medium"
  subnet_id    = module.vpc.public_subnet_id
}

module "rds" {
  source = "./modules/rds"
  
  db_name     = "webapp"
  instance_class = "db.t3.micro"
  subnet_ids  = [module.vpc.private_subnet_id]
}
```

**WORKFLOW**

```bash
# Development
cd environments/dev
terraform init
terraform plan    # Review changes
terraform apply   # Apply to dev

# Production
cd environments/prod
terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars
terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars
```

examples.input: Create Kubernetes infrastructure on GCP with GKE, Cloud SQL, and networking using Terraform.
